kharagpur-2012.notes: Scoreboard (source 2) has 39 team rows, the API standings 40; the earlier reader counted 40 for source 2. No contest date appears in the copies.

sources.evidence: Home page titled 'ACM ICPC 2012' says IIT Kharagpur plays host to this year's ACM ICPC, and the registration page names The 2012 ACM-ICPC Asia Kharagpur Regional Contest.
Word-exported page titled 'Summary - Programming Contest' with a grid of 39 team rows and columns Rank, Name, Solved, Time, A to H and Total att/solv.
Page says it is rendered from the icpc.global public API archive and holds 40 teams with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation and no per-problem columns.
